description: Use when a user wants their site to be found or cited by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini), asks about GEO/AEO, or wonders why an assistant does not mention their site. Fetches up to 5 URLs of the public site (page, robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt) and returns a 0-100 score, seven weighted checks with status, points, evidence label (A proven, B study, C unproven) and a one-line finding, plus up to 5 top fixes ranked by points gained and a next step. Deterministic, no LLM; results are cached for 24 hours. Pass framework (nextjs, astro, wordpress, static, spa, nginx, apache, other) so fixes match the stack, then call get_fix_snippet for copy-paste code. Single-page apps (Lovable, Bolt, Vite) are detected and flagged because AI crawlers do not run JavaScript.

framework.description: The site's stack, so fixes match. Omit to auto-detect.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain of the page to audit, for example https://example.com

name: audit_ai_readiness
